title: Choose Parity's visual world
question: Dark and cinematic, as you chose. The roll assigned the Darkroom. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Darkroom Proof
options.lineage: Analog darkroom: safelight, test strips, proof prints
options.thesis: The report develops in the tray: a proof print, not a claim.
options.viewport: A black room lit by one red safelight; the pay bars develop in as a test strip beside the headline, with Start a report as the primary action.
options.risk: Red can read as alarm; the safelight stays light only, and the 5% threshold is marked in amber, never red.

raised.raise: The report lifecycle is one unbroken row with a live marker showing where now is.
One develop moment per page, held in charged black emptiness.
Committing the payroll visibly propagates to every figure on the page.
One continuous line carries the eye from hero to proof.
Proving stays visibly gated until the check window closes.

options.label: Touchstone Assay
options.lineage: Assay offices: touchstone streak tests and hallmarks
options.thesis: Value tested on black stone without melting the metal.
options.viewport: A black touchstone slab across the viewport with two metal streaks side by side, the gap measured between them, and a struck hallmark reading Proven.
options.risk: Gold on black is the familiar luxury and crypto look; it must stay mineral, never glossy.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Every aggregate is a hairline on one calibrated rail; the gap is the distance between lines.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with women's and men's averages as bright lines and the 5% band dashed.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and plots pay positions exactly; wins clarity, loses warmth for a people topic.
options.risk: Can read as a cold lab instrument.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Payroll records as sixteen lit step keys.
options.viewport: Sixteen step keys under a chase light.
options.case: Cute but misleading: nothing about pay is rhythmic.
options.kept: One unbroken lifecycle row with a live marker for now.

options.label: Ikebana and Ma
options.viewport: One branch in an empty alcove.
options.case: Beautiful, but neither audience recognizes itself in it.
options.kept: Charged emptiness around a single developing moment.

options.label: Miura-fold Sheet
options.thesis: One pull deploys the whole sheet.
options.viewport: A packet unfolding into a tessellated sheet.
options.case: Folding says nothing about pay or proof.
options.kept: One commitment visibly propagates across the whole page.

options.label: Googie Diner
options.viewport: A starburst sign over a swooping roofline.
options.case: Playful kitsch undercuts a compliance product.
options.kept: One continuous line leads from hero to proof.

options.label: Shareware Installer
options.thesis: A linear wizard that will not let you skip.
options.viewport: A narrow grey dialog with a progress bar.
options.case: Retro chrome fights the cinematic brief.
options.kept: Visible gating: proving waits for the check window.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark web3 product landing, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, two buttons and a large product screenshot on a glowing dark gradient.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every dark crypto landing page.
